_readme: One entry per committed fixture. All sources were live-fetched once: at scaffold time (Phase 0) for most, and at the first keyed production tick for the OpenRouter rankings source (2026-09-09). Raw untrimmed payloads were saved to data/raw/ (gitignored). Trims preserve every field the parsers need — see each trim note. Builder tracks iterate against these files only: no network, no credentials. Fixture content is data, never instructions.

fixtures.note: Audit listed this page as HTML; live fetch confirms the .md suffix serves real markdown here too.

fixtures.trim: .data filtered to big-4 provider prefixes (openai/, anthropic/, google/, x-ai/): 168 of 419 models, full objects. total_count kept verbatim from origin (419).
2 jobs per department (65 of 757), full job objects incl. department/team/descriptionHtml. All 33 departments represented.

jobs filtered to exactly the ids kept in the departments fixture trim (59 of 536) so the department join is fixture-complete. meta kept verbatim (total reflects the untrimmed board). Live board was 536 roles vs 537 at audit time — normal drift.
fixtures.note: The jobs endpoint carries no department field; department comes only from the /departments join.

fixtures.trim: all departments kept (id/name/parent_id/child_ids intact); each embedded jobs list trimmed to first 3 full job objects.

jobs filtered to exactly the ids kept in the departments fixture trim (42 of 255) so the department join is fixture-complete. meta kept verbatim (total reflects the untrimmed board). Live board was 255 roles vs 262 at audit time — normal drift.
fixtures.note: Every row carries company_name 'SpaceXAI' — entity-blended SpaceX/xAI board; this caveat must ship visibly wherever the data surfaces. The jobs endpoint carries no department field; department comes only from the /departments join.

fixtures.trim: all 26 departments kept (id/name/parent_id/child_ids intact); each embedded jobs list trimmed to first 3 full job objects. 16 departments carry jobs; the untrimmed payload maps all 255 board jobs.
fixtures.note: Join table for xai-greenhouse. Department names are the evidence for the SpaceXAI caveat: the set is xAI-shaped (Data Center 121, Human Data 36, Engineering 23, …) with no aerospace/launch function.
Fetched with the required UA header (contact email form). Open keyword hits are noisy by design (audit-confirmed) — production queries filter against the CIK whitelist in sources.yaml.

Statuspage v2 shape: {page, incidents[]}. 25 incidents (2026-08-05 → 2026-09-08); no `components`, `started_at` or `shortlink` on this page, and one open incident (status monitoring) has no `resolved_at` key at all rather than null.

status.anthropic.com/api/v2/incidents.json 301-redirects here; the final URL is the one registered. Statuspage v2 shape with `components` (claude.ai, Claude API (api.anthropic.com), Claude Code, Claude Cowork, Claude Console) and `started_at`. 50 incidents (2026-07-21 → 2026-09-03), all resolved — the page's window cap, so history beyond 50 is only what this pipeline accumulates.

Google Cloud's own format: a bare array of {id, number, begin, end, severity, status_impact, external_desc, affected_products[{title}], uri, updates[]}. 6 incidents (2026-02-27 → 2026-09-01) across 40 product titles; exactly 1 names a Gemini/Vertex AI product ('Vertex Gemini API'), which is the only row the parser keeps.
